name: DGME medical and dental college lists — Rangpur Division
organization: Directorate General of Medical Education (DGME), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
attribution: Source: Directorate General of Medical Education (dgme.gov.bd)
notes: Same DGME HTML tables as the Rajshahi run: 'সরকারি/বেসরকারি মেডিকেল কলেজ' (college code, name, year established, MBBS seats; page updated 18 Dec 2025) and 'সরকারি/বেসরকারি ডেন্টাল কলেজ/ইউনিট' (updated 20 May 2024). Rows kept when the name's district suffix is in Rangpur Division. Dental units are attached to their parent medical college in extra_json. English names/websites for government colleges come from the 'সরকারী মেডিকেল কলেজ (সকল)' page, matched by district (Dinajpur not matched: DGME spells it 'Dinajpur Medical Collge'). No addresses, phones or coordinates. Licence not stated.
